policyRes.description: All URLs assigned to webhooks are being accessed via SSL/TLS.

policyRes.name: Webhooks should use a secret key
policyRes.description: A secret should be added everytime a webhook is added or modified.

policyRes.name: Webhook URLs must not have malicious reputation
policyRes.description: A webhook URL should not be malicious based on Virus Total reputation.

policyRes.name: Webhook URLs must not have suspicious reputation
policyRes.description: A webhook URL should not be suspicious based on Virus Total reputation.

policyRes.name: Webhook URLs must not have unknown reputation
policyRes.description: A webhook URL should not be unknown based on Virus Total reputation.
